summary: TypeScript SDK: request abort/cancel support for streaming chat
description: Customer asks how to cancel an in-flight streaming chat request (e.g., user navigates away). They want AbortController support and docs examples. No bug reported; current workaround is closing the underlying fetch/reader.
comments: Support (Connor): Provided workaround: call controller.abort() on the fetch used to create the stream; noted SDK does not expose it yet.
PM (Avery): Asked customer which runtimes (browser vs node) and whether they need partial transcript handling on cancel. Waiting for response.
